scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@cairn/design-tokens && npm run build --workspace=@cairn/design-system-catalog && npm run build --workspace=@cairn/ui && npm run build --workspace=@cairn/showcase
scripts.showcase: npm run build && npm run preview --workspace=@cairn/showcase
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run verify:catalog && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:test --workspaces --if-present
